company.name: SmartPath
company.shortDescription: SmartPath provides objective, trustworthy, and affordable advice to help everyday employees reach financial well-being.
company.description:
SmartPath was founded in the shadow of the Great Recession to provide objective, trustworthy, and affordable advice to help everyday people reach financial well-being.

2020 has illuminated the prominence of existing income disparities in this country and exacerbated the stress of those one emergency away from financial calamity. 

Our combination of empathetic financial coaching, targeted and timely education and easy-to-use digital and mobile tools meet employees where they are to help turn their stress into financial success.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $1,574,998, or 35.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,291,528 to $19,337,690, a 5.87x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
